item.title: [DE|Local] BR24 Thema des Tages (Bayern) (Fri 19:00): Tag der Deutschen Einheit: Wie steht es um das "Wir-Gefühl"?
item.description:
Originally published Fri 02 Oct 2026 19:00 IDT.
Marode Schulen, mehr Kriminalität, Angst vor Armut - viele Menschen in den neuen Bundesländern sind frustriert. Das zeigt sich auch an den Wahlergebnissen. Morgen ist die Deutsche Wiedervereinigung zwar 36 Jahre her - aber warum gibt es bis heute Unterschiede in Ost- und West? Und kann man wirklich von einem "Wir-Gefühl" sprechen?
Moderation: Tanja Sluka Beitrag: Mario Neumann Gesprächspartner: Heinz Bude, Soziologe

item.title: [EN|In-Depth] BBC Global News Podcast (Sat 07:09): Christa Pike: What next after failed execution?
item.description:
Originally published Sat 03 Oct 2026 07:09 IDT.

Christa Pike's legal representatives say the convicted murderer is unconscious and on a ventilator in hospital in Tennessee, after surviving two lethal injections on Wednesday. They have requested that all evidence related to the incident be preserved. We hear the account of Nashville reporter Steven Hale, one of a small number of journalists who witnessed the botched execution.

Also: G7 leaders agree to release up to 100 million barrels of diesel and crude reserves, days after President Trump's threat to ban diesel exports from the US. New York Governor Kathy Hochul says the woman at the centre of the Cornell University rape case was "failed" at "every turn". She also announces plans to change state law around consent. Argentina becomes the latest nation to offer citizenship to foreigners who invest large sums of money in the country. The swimming classes helping child amputees in Gaza. SpaceX astronaut Jessica Watkins has made history by becoming the first black female commander to lead a crew into orbit, breaking a US speed record in the process. And what is the true cost of buying a home for just one euro in Italy?
